Alger, 10 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 10, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — IRIS announces the availability of its new Q7700 smartphone, designed to deliver an exceptional gaming experience with cutting-edge graphic and sound technologies.
IRIS lance le Q7700, un smartphone pensé: IRIS launches the Q7700, a smartphone designed for gamers.
Ce nouveau modèle promet une immersion t: This new model promises total immersion thanks to its 4K HDR compatible screen, offering remarkable gaming fluidity with a 144Hz refresh rate and VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) technology. Avec le IRIS Q7700, la marque algérienne: With the IRIS Q7700, the Algerian brand aims to position this product as a device enabling users to "play at the highest level", emphasizing visual and sound quality for an optimized user experience.
